verdict.rationale: Oneleet lists SOC 2 among its supported frameworks and automatically adds controls when a framework is enabled. It ships Formal and Comprehensive policy templates with a draft, review and publish workflow, and its integrations (AWS, GitHub, Google Workspace) monitor configurations that can feed compliance work. The evidence never addresses Type I versus Type II audits, never names the Trust Services Criteria, and never describes built-in evidence requests, so end-to-end delivery is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit SOC 2 Type I and Type II support, documented mapping of controls to the Trust Services Criteria, built-in evidence request workflows, documentation of the audit handoff, independent or hands-on corroboration.
